attempts.summary: Configured node1 as the source of truth for `/etc/inventory/app.conf`. An enabled systemd timer synchronizes content or deletion to node2 every minute. Automatic propagation completed in 45 seconds and deletion in 60 seconds. Both nodes restarted sequentially and recovered with changed boot identities; post-restart synchronization succeeded. The temporary test file was removed, restoring the initial absent state on both nodes.
